extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question: (1) 'island' labels had case and space variants ('Dream ' and 'torgersen') which were normalized to 'Dream' and 'Torgersen'; (2) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas (e.g. '3,150'), which was converted to numbers; (3) three rows had impossible negative flipper lengths (-215, -228, -198 mm), which were excluded; (4) one row had an impossible body mass of 3,550,000 g, which was excluded. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species is: Adelie: 117,250 g, Chinstrap: 55,625 g, Gentoo: 70,175 g.
